decisionsTitle: A person's emails with their tries: «Emailuri» on a volunteer's page, «Încercări și cine le-a trimis» inside a registration's «Emailuri», and «Emailuri azi»'s names as links
decisionsSection:
**The ask, 2026-11-04** (the design «telling the owner about every email a staff press sends», after slice 3): for each person, the list of emails the outbox holds for them, with how many tries each took — on the registration's own page and on the volunteer's own page — and, on «Emailuri azi», each person line one tap from that person's page.

**Decision — one reader.** `notifications/email-history.ts#readEmailHistory(db, actor, { registrationId } | { volunteerId }, now)`: every outbox row of one registration (`registration_id`, by `email_outbox_registration_created_idx`) or of one volunteer (the payload's `volunteerId`, matched by the journal's own join, now the exported predicate `journal.ts#VOLUNTEER_OF_ROW`), newest first, in **one query** — the colleague's name by a left join on `requested_by_staff_user_id`, and two window counts (every row, and the person's own) so «Și încă N» needs no second count — capped at 200 rows. A waiting row's departure is the queue's one judgement (`domain/departure.ts#departureOf`, §529), its context read only when a row waits (the governor's floor as this instance last heard it, as the toast after a press reads it, never a request to Neon); the Gmail road of a row is `outbox.ts#onGmailRoadOf`, the claim's own rule from the row's facts, so the payload is never read for it. **What is read**: the type, the state and its times, `attempt_count` and `next_attempt_at`, `delivered_at` / `rejected_at` / `rejection_cause`, `cause` and `press_id`, who pressed, `is_manual_resend`, the club-copy flag and the two flags the departure needs; a FAILED row's sanitized `last_error` and no other row's (a waiting row's last answer is read only for the departure's pause mark). **Never**: the payload's words, a body, a link, the provider's code or words. **Who**: the Administrator and the Superadministrator, asserted in the reader (`canManageRegistrations`, the capability that gates «Emailuri azi»); every other role — the desk's, the Organizer, Tehnic — gets FORBIDDEN, never an empty list that reads as «none» (BR-REQ-060-01). An erased person's rows went with them (the cascade); a volunteer's page is a 404 once the row is gone.

**Decision — one fold, the journal's pieces.** `notifications/ui/EmailHistory.tsx`: a closed fold with the mail glyph, its line «4 emailuri · ultimul: „Înscriere confirmată” — a plecat la 10:15» (`emails.today.lines` by `countForm`, no ICU plural), and inside, every email stacked so a row fits 320 pixels, never a table: its name (`Admin.emails.types`); when it was queued and by what, in «Emailuri azi»'s press words (`10:02 · Anulează înscrierea · de Ana Pop`, `… · automat: întreținerea înscrierilor`, for a row the site's own flows queued `… · de pe site` — the journal's words, which say where from and never who: a person's cancel from their link queues the next person's offer too, so «persoana însăși» would be false (the re-review), and `… · nu s-a notat cine l-a trimis` for a row nobody was recorded for — see «De pe site» below); the journal's state chip (`DepartedChip`, exported) or «Așteaptă» with the queue's departure words; «Retrimis manual»; the tries — «încă nu s-a încercat» while it waits untried, «1 încercare», «3 încercări», «20 de încercări» — and, on a PENDING row already tried at least once, «următoarea încercare: 12:30» (the ask read «when more than one»; one try made is already a retry waiting, and its time is what the owner asks); delivered or refused in the words of the registration's «Emailuri» (§671: «Livrat …», «Respins … — Căsuța e plină», «Marcat ca spam …»); a FAILED row's «Ultimul răspuns al furnizorului: …»; the club's copies folded under their message by the idempotency key's prefix (`journal.ts#copiedKey`, exported), «+ N pentru căsuțele clubului», and the club's other rows (the declaration's archive, a notice to the club's people, a copy whose message is past the cap) in one such fold under the list. `ClubFold`, `DepartedChip`, `emailTypeName` and the translator's type are exported from `EmailJournal.tsx` for it; no new chip, no new words where the journal or the queue had them — `Admin.emails.history.*` holds only the fold's own (its titles, its line, the tries, «de pe site», «nu s-a notat cine l-a trimis»).

**Decision — «de pe site» only where it is known.** A public flow opens no press (`domain/press-causes.ts`), so the person's own rows carry neither a press nor a colleague; but neither does any row queued before `cause` and `press_id` existed (migration 0192, the same day): the race's reminders, the maintenance job's expiries and offers, a staff verb that did not stamp `requested_by_staff_user_id`. Calling every such row «de pe site» would answer the fold's very question — who sent it — wrongly for almost the whole history the outbox held when this shipped. So a row with neither is «de pe site» (`EmailHistoryRow.fromSite`, `data-cause="site"`) only when it was queued at or after the **outbox's first recorded press**, read in the same query as an uncorrelated subquery (`min(created_at) where press_id is not null`, computed once); before it, and in an outbox that has recorded no press at all, the row says «… · nu s-a notat cine l-a trimis» / “… · who sent it was not recorded” (`data-cause="unrecorded"`). Not the moment drizzle's table keeps for 0192: it holds the migration's authored time, not when the code that stamps presses began to serve, and each environment released it at its own hour; not a constant, for the same reason. The rule errs on the side of saying nothing: once retention removes the earliest presses, an older row of the person's own may say «nu s-a notat» too, and only the release's own minute — an old instance finishing a request after the new one stamped its first press — can still call a job's row the site's.

**Where.** On the **volunteer's page** (`/admin/volunteers/[id]`, §839) a level-3 card «Emailuri» / “Emails” under the person's block, at `#emailuri`. On the **registration's page** the card «Emailuri» exists since §671 and every reader of the page reads it (§289): a second card of the same name would list the same emails twice under two equal headings. So the fold is a level-4 fold **inside** that card, «Încercări și cine le-a trimis» / “Tries and who sent them”, under the club's rows and above the legend; the card, its story, its rows with the provider's small print and its count stay as they are for every reader, and the Organizer — who keeps the card (§671) — gets no fold. For the Administrator the card thus shows each email twice, in two shapes: the §671 row with the provider's small print, and the fold's row with its tries and who caused it, from a second query over the same index. Folding the tries and the cause into the §671 rows would be the leaner design (one list, one query) and is left for a later pass, should the owner prefer it; this one leaves the Organizer's card and its tests as they were. On **«Emailuri azi»** (`/admin/settings/emails/today`) each person line's name is a plain anchor to the person's page, 44 pixels tall above its words so the line stays as tall as its words (`INLINE_TAP_TARGET`, the in-sentence shape of §480) — the club's fold above such a line is positioned so its bar keeps its own presses, and a many-people fold leaves its first name's reach free (§366): the registration's for a line named from the registration, the volunteer's for the volunteer's own messages and their parent's link (`JournalLine.person`); a colleague's line, an address with no name and every club line link nowhere.

**Left out on purpose.** A count of emails or tries on the registrations list: its query is the hot page's and stays untouched; a migration: `registration_id` is indexed (`email_outbox_registration_created_idx`), and a volunteer's rows are matched on the payload, which no index holds — a volunteer's page is opened rarely and the outbox is small, so an expression index (it would be migration 0194) is not worth its write cost today; a fold for the Organizer (the brief keeps tries and who pressed with the two roles that read «Emailuri azi»); the provider's code and words in the new fold (the §671 card keeps them); a fold on a member's, a colleague's or an invitation's page (no such page shows emails yet); a person's emails across events (one registration, one volunteer row each).

Amends §671 (the card holds the Administrator's fold), §839 (the volunteer's page) and §912 (the journal's names link).
changelogLine: - **Every email to a person, with its tries** — a volunteer's page has a closed «Emailuri» fold, and a registration's «Emailuri» card a fold «Încercări și cine le-a trimis»: every email the outbox holds for them, newest first, with how many tries it took and the next one, when it was queued and by which press and colleague (or «automat», or «de pe site»), what became of it, a failure's reason and the club's copies under it — for the Administrator and the Superadministrator only; on «Emailuri azi» each person's name opens their page. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a registration's page, when an Administrator or a Superadministrator opens it, then its «Emailuri» card holds a closed fold «Încercări și cine le-a trimis» / “Tries and who sent them” with the mail glyph, whose line says how many emails the person has and the latest with its state («4 emailuri · ultimul: „…” — a plecat la 10:15»), listing every outbox row of the registration newest first, stacked — its name; when it was queued and by what (the press and the colleague, «automat» for a job, «de pe site» for the person's own form or link, said only of a row with neither press nor colleague queued at or after the outbox's first recorded press, and «nu s-a notat cine l-a trimis» for any other row with neither, such as a reminder queued before presses were recorded); the state chip or, while it waits, the queue's departure words; «Retrimis manual»; the tries («încă nu s-a încercat», «1 încercare», «3 încercări», «20 de încercări») and, on a waiting row tried before, the next try; delivered or refused with its cause in words; a FAILED row's sanitized reason and nothing else of the provider; and the club's copies folded under their message as «+ N pentru căsuțele clubului» — never the payload's words, a body or a link, at most 200 rows with «Și încă N»; the Organizer's card is as before, with no fold (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteer's page in the backoffice, when an Administrator or a Superadministrator opens it, then a closed «Emailuri» / “Emails” fold lists, as a registration's fold does, every outbox row whose payload names that volunteer — their own messages and their parent's link — newest first with its tries and who caused it, the colleagues' notice among the club's rows and another volunteer's never; the Organizer, who opens the page for the roles, gets no fold (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a person's email history (`readEmailHistory`, a registration's or a volunteer's), when anyone but an Administrator or a Superadministrator asks for it — a desk role, the Organizer, the Tehnic role — then the server refuses it with FORBIDDEN, never an empty list, and neither the registration's page nor the volunteer's page draws its fold for them (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Emailuri azi», then each person line's name is a plain link at least 44 pixels tall, its line no taller than its words, to the person's own page — the registration's for a line named from the registration, the volunteer's for the volunteer's own messages and their parent's link — and a colleague's line, an address with no name and every club line link nowhere (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: a person's emails with their tries on the registration's and the volunteer's page, and «Emailuri azi»'s names as links
